Public docs information architecture and Markdown rendering passed content tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, whitespace checks, and 1440px Headless Edge review after adding project protocol/TASK/HANDOFF explanations, replacing internal release detail with approval boundaries, and removing obsolete command prose.

Replaced both legacy SVG diagrams with responsive native HTML/CSS authority-flow and six-stage lifecycle rail/detail views; documented TASK_BOARD.md as the project capsule index; compacted hero and overview typography; npm test, TypeScript/Vite production build, git diff --check, and 1920px light-theme Headless Edge visual inspection passed without observed text overflow or connector collision.

Removed page-level audience badges; enlarged Home Get started and View lifecycle CTAs to readable 48px controls with 14px labels and stronger contrast; hardened native diagrams from the Runtime Master Plan v3 schematic grammar with focal/store/external roles, labeled request/operate/project/review and guarded-write flow, connected lifecycle stages, protocol surfaces, invariants, and lifecycle guarantees while retaining the docs paper/gold/teal visual language. Content regression tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, git diff --check, and Headless Edge light-theme visual QA passed at 1920px and 430px widths.

Final visual hardening verification passed after aligning the HADARA protocol guarded-write connector directly over canonical project state, preserving canonical-to-projection-to-human review direction, and removing mobile shell width overflow. npm test, TypeScript/Vite production build, git diff --check, evidence lint, and Headless Edge light-theme captures passed at 1920px and 500px; audience badges remain absent and Home CTAs remain legible.

Repaired protocol-page section hierarchy: filename headings now use integrated borderless monospace labels instead of inline-code pills; npm test, TypeScript/Vite production build, git diff check, and 1920px light-theme long-page visual inspection passed without observed awkward wrapping.

Lifecycle diagram redesign validation initially failed because the content contract still required the superseded label 'Lifecycle guarantee' after the diagram renamed that semantic group to 'Lifecycle guards'; the implementation exposed a stale regression expectation, not a runtime rendering failure.

Redesigned the lifecycle diagram as a true process: six connected stages are now the primary desktop structure, the selected stage opens a compact reads-to-produces contract panel, durable cross-session state forms a foundation rail, and lifecycle guards remain a separate footer. Content tests, TypeScript/Vite build, diff check, and 1920px desktop plus 500px mobile Edge captures passed without observed overflow. This resolves the stale-label contract failure.

The first four Edge visual-QA captures for the onboarding/recovery documentation were invalid because the local preview server had exited and Edge returned ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED; those images did not assess page rendering.

Expanded public onboarding with preset differences, observable init writes, vendor-neutral AGENTS.md agent connection, real TASK/HANDOFF/EVIDENCE examples, inline routing to Evidence and Approval pages, and a Limits & Recovery page; replaced the 2.0 MB PNG with a 132792-byte WebP. Content tests, TypeScript/Vite production build, git diff check, and successful Headless Edge review of Getting Started, What is HADARA, Task Capsules, and Limits & Recovery passed without observed overflow. This resolves the earlier preview-server connection-refused capture failure.
